registry_info.description: Structures grown by chance for the Randomness sequence.

random_pipe_lattice.name: Random pipe lattice
random_pipe_lattice.description: A lattice grown by chance, ported from Palle's Rhino script: a size x size grid of points stacked in levels 1 m apart (spacing), every point piped straight up, and piped to each of eight neighbours on the next level only when a random draw beats prob (0.6 = a 40 % chance each). Quirks of the script kept: only points short of the last row and column start pipes, the 'away left' draw repeats 'away up', and Python's negative indices wrap some pipes to the far side (neighbours:local drops those). Pipes and joints are solid. Origin = centre of the bottom level. Config: #seed #prob #size #levels #spacing #pipe_radius #deviation #neighbours:as_written|local
